keep.reason: German Gen is coined from Greek genea (descent).
Gens is the genitive of German Gen.
German Genealogen derives through Greek genealogos with genea as its first component.

reason: The other 14,651 German members were assigned solely through a candidate-index match of the short sequence gen. Common unrelated endings in erfolgen, sorgen, bestätigen, entscheidungen and thousands more do not establish descent from Greek genea. Preserve the three specified members; keep other languages' members untouched.
review_scope: A family-language evidence-class decision, not individual etymological annotation of all rejected members. Any further true derived words omitted by the candidate matcher require separately documented restoration.
